newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatneft to sell $200-$300 mln Eurobond in Sept-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Tatneft to sell $200-$300 mln Eurobond in Sept-Oct.

text.p: Russian oil company NK Tatneft plans to place of its $200-$300 million Eurobond issue in September or October this year via Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Tatneft's Russian adviser said on Wednesday.
"We hope to finish Eurobond placement this September or October," Bank Zenit Chairman Alexei Sokolov told a news conference, adding that the preliminary issue volume was $200-$300 million.
He also said the company had chosen Dresdner Kleinwort Benson to lead manage the issue.
Sokolov said his bank was working on receiving a central bank licence for the issue and on getting credit ratings. He said the bank expected Tatneft to get the ratings in August.

Tatneft, located in Russia's autonomous Tatar Republic, also plans to issue level-three American Depositary Receipts, which will raise capital. It has already issued level-one ADRs, and made a private placement of American Depositary Shares in London through Kleinworts.
Sokolov said the new ADRs would be placed in November or December this year.

Tatneft joins a long queue of Russian companies planning Eurobond issues. Other firms include Almazy Rossii-Sakha diamond producer, Gazprom natural gas monopoly and Red October confectioner. Several regional governments and banks as well as the federal government have already issued Eurobonds.
